You can easily fit all your brushes in the tin, plus additional smaller items, throw it in your bag, purse, or luggage, and take it on the go.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as super soft and gentle.
Many reviewers love the tin case, calling it handy for travel and storage.
Several reviewers note the brushes do not shed.
A few reviewers mention a chemical smell when first opening the product.
Some reviewers complain the brushes are small, sparsely bristled, or shed, with one reporting a broken brush on arrival.
